blocks.html: The details of the product to create.

types.name: CreateProductWorkflowInputDTO
types.description: The details of the product to create.

children.name: id
children.description: Optionally pass an ID when creating a product.

children.name: title
children.description: The title of the product.

children.name: subtitle
children.description: The subttle of the product.

children.name: description
children.description: The description of the product.

children.name: is_giftcard
children.description: Whether the product is a gift card.

children.name: discountable
children.description: Whether the product can be discounted.

children.name: thumbnail
children.description: The URL of the product's thumbnail.

children.name: handle
children.description:
The handle of the product. The handle can be used to create slug URL paths.
If not supplied, the value of the `handle` attribute of the product is set to the slug version of the `title` attribute.

children.name: status
children.description: The status of the product.

children.name: images
children.description: The associated images to created or updated.

children.name: id
children.description:
The product image's ID. If not provided, the image is created. In
that case, the `url` property is required.

children.name: url
children.description: The new URL of the product image.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.

children.name: external_id
children.description: The id of the product in an external system

children.name: type_id
children.description: The product type id to associate with the product.

children.name: collection_id
children.description: The product collection to associate with the product.

children.name: tag_ids
children.description: The tags to be associated with the product.

children.name: category_ids
children.description: The product categories to associate with the product.

children.name: options
children.description: The product options to be created and/or associated with the product.

children.name: title
children.description: The product option's title.

children.name: values
children.description: The product option values.

children.name: ranks
children.description: The rank for each option value. The key is the option value, and the value is the rank.

children.name: is_exclusive
children.description: Whether the product option is exclusive to a product or shared across products.

children.name: metadata
children.description: The metadata of the product option.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the product option to link.

children.name: value_ids
children.description: The IDs of specific option values to link. If undefined, every value will be added to the product by default.

children.name: width
children.description: The width of the product.

children.name: height
children.description: The height of the product.

children.name: length
children.description: The length of the product.

children.name: weight
children.description: The weight of the product.

children.name: origin_country
children.description: The origin country of the product.

children.name: hs_code
children.description: The HS Code of the product.

children.name: material
children.description: The material of the product.

children.name: mid_code
children.description: The MID Code of the product.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.

children.name: sales_channels
children.description: The sales channels that the product is available in.

children.name: shipping_profile_id
children.description: The product's shipping profile.

children.name: variants
children.description: The product's variants.

children.name: product_id
children.description: The id of the product

children.name: title
children.description: The tile of the product variant.

children.name: sku
children.description: The SKU of the product variant.

children.name: barcode
children.description: The barcode of the product variant.

children.name: ean
children.description: The EAN of the product variant.

children.name: upc
children.description: The UPC of the product variant.

children.name: allow_backorder
children.description: Whether the product variant can be ordered when it's out of stock.

children.name: manage_inventory
children.description: Whether the product variant's inventory should be managed by the core system.

children.name: inventory_items
children.description:
The variant's inventory items. It's only
available if `manage_inventory` is enabled.

children.name: hs_code
children.description: The HS Code of the product variant.

children.name: origin_country
children.description: The origin country of the product variant.

children.name: mid_code
children.description: The MID Code of the product variant.

children.name: material
children.description: The material of the product variant.

children.name: weight
children.description: The weight of the product variant.

children.name: length
children.description: The length of the product variant.

children.name: height
children.description: The height of the product variant.

children.name: width
children.description: The width of the product variant.

children.name: options
children.description:
The options of the variant. Each key is an option's title, and value
is an option's value. If an option with the specified title doesn't exist,
a new one is created.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.

children.name: prices
children.description: The variant's prices.
